historical_record.description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment.
Built as an industrial building, recorded as occupied by David Woerner Cooperage Co. Designed by C. A. Meussdorffer.
Survived the earthquake and fire, as recorded in USGS Bulletin 324.
Built as part of the David Woerner Cooperage Company plant; a brick warehouse, one of several parts of the plant surviving from this period.

unknowns: The survey's data table dates the building to 1900; the context statement's appendix dates it to Ca. 1913.

historic_survey.physical_integrity: 7 of 7 aspects retained, on the survey's scale
historic_survey.note: The survey rates the architecture 5 of 5. The 2009 context statement gives the status code 3CD; the 2011 survey data table gives 3S. California Register criteria cited: 1,2,3.
historic_survey.status_code_meaning: California Historical Resource Status Codes: a 1 or 2 means listed or formally determined eligible, a 3 means the survey judged it eligible, a 5 means locally significant, a 6 that it was found ineligible, and a 7 that it was not evaluated.
